environment.load_note: Own bounded allocation; serial after owned heldout worker pools completed. Other node load not measured; no existing jobs inspected.

warm.batch_cpu_note: Includes warmup, Agent construction and validation outside act timers.
warm.cpu_timing_note: Process CPU intervals include two wall-clock marker calls. OS CPU accounting can be coarse (many zero samples on Windows); CPU per-act percentiles do not establish sub-ms precision. Wall intervals bracket act only.

cold.batch_cpu_note: Includes per-case Agent construction/cache clearing and validation outside act timers.
cold.note: First act on an in-hand observation with empty seat priors; process/asset startup is excluded.
cold.cpu_timing_note: Process CPU intervals include two wall-clock marker calls. OS CPU accounting can be coarse (many zero samples on Windows); CPU per-act percentiles do not establish sub-ms precision. Wall intervals bracket act only.

artificial_uncached_icm.batch_cpu_note: Includes artificial state construction/cache clearing and validation outside act timers.
artificial_uncached_icm.note: Eight live table stacks, six folded hands, heads-up all-in; unequal starting stacks total2000 chips. This measures an artificial worst-size ICM context, not game frequency.
artificial_uncached_icm.cpu_timing_note: Process CPU intervals include two wall-clock marker calls. OS CPU accounting can be coarse (many zero samples on Windows); CPU per-act percentiles do not establish sub-ms precision. Wall intervals bracket act only.

limitations: Local Python/hardware timing; official hardware and adapter are unavailable.
Module import/model load, Agent construction, observation construction and JSON transport excluded.
Wall-clock scheduling pauses count as overruns; no hard deadline is guaranteed.
Replay uses recorded game states; artificial ICM stress is separately identified.
Fresh-Agent cold replay measures an empty table profile, not a fresh OS process.

in_game_deadline.note: Same-policy paired seeds; scheduling-driven timeouts can change all seats' play and later card assignment. This is local timing behavior, not an official performance estimate.
